posts.title: When you are a jerk
posts.description: Like they say in The Four Agreements by Don Miguel Ruiz and Janet Mills, when someone is awful to you, it’s more often than not, not about you at all. I suppose we can turn that on its head and say if you are angry–no, when you are nasty to someone for no good reason–it’s more about what’s going inside your head than what the person has done.
